items.exampleEn: The faculty of medicine is the oldest part of the university.
items.exampleZh: 醫學院是這所大學歷史最悠久的部分。

items.exampleEn: The engineer drew a simple circuit on the board.
items.exampleZh: 工程師在黑板上畫了一個簡單的電路。

items.exampleEn: Staff are instructed not to give out customers' phone numbers.
items.exampleZh: 員工被指示不得把顧客的電話號碼告訴別人。

items.exampleEn: This machine offers instant translation of signs and menus.
items.exampleZh: 這部機器能即時翻譯招牌和菜單。

items.exampleEn: The bank held a free seminar on starting a small business.
items.exampleZh: 那家銀行舉辦了一場關於創業的免費研討會。

items.exampleEn: Tuition at this music school includes one free concert ticket each month.
items.exampleZh: 這所音樂學校的學費包含每個月一張免費音樂會門票。

items.exampleEn: After years of correspondence, the two pen pals finally met in person.
items.exampleZh: 兩位筆友通信多年後，終於見面了。

items.exampleEn: At the trade fair, a translator helped our boss talk with foreign buyers.
items.exampleZh: 在貿易展上，一位翻譯人員協助我們老闆和外國買家溝通。

items.sentenceEn: Our teacher instructed us to read chapter five before Monday.
items.sentenceZh: 老師指示我們在星期一前讀完第五章。

items.audioEn: The seminar on climate science starts at two in Room 304, not in the main hall.
items.audioZh: 氣候科學研討會兩點在 304 教室開始，不是在大禮堂。

items.sentenceEn: She works as a translator for a publishing company.
items.sentenceZh: 她在一家出版社擔任譯者。

items.sentenceEn: If the circuit is broken, the light will not turn on.
items.sentenceZh: 如果電路斷了，燈就不會亮。

items.stemEn: Members of the science ____ meet once a month to discuss research.
items.stemZh: 理學院的教師每個月開一次會，討論研究。

items.stemEn: I read the novel in ____ because I can't read the original language.
items.stemZh: 我讀的是這本小說的譯本，因為我看不懂原文。

items.passageEn: My sister is studying in the language faculty at a university abroad. Her tuition is high, so she also works part-time as a translator for a small travel company. Last week, she attended a seminar on the history of translation, where a professor showed old correspondence between writers in different countries. The professor instructed the students to translate one letter for homework. My sister says the work is challenging but rewarding. On weekends, she relaxes by running a circuit around the campus lake to train for her first marathon, and she often sends us photos of the lake at sunset.
items.passageZh: 我姊姊在國外一所大學的語言學院念書。她的學費很高，所以她也在一家小旅行社兼職當譯者。上週，她參加了一場關於翻譯歷史的研討會，一位教授展示了不同國家作家之間的往來信件。教授指示學生把其中一封信翻譯出來當作業。姊姊說這份工作很有挑戰性，但很有收穫。週末，她會繞著校園湖跑一圈來放鬆，順便為她的第一場馬拉松做準備，也常寄給我們湖上夕陽的照片。

questions.questionZh: 姊姊為什麼要兼職當譯者？
options: 因為旅行社是家人開的

items.promptZh: 我們和那家公司保持了好幾年的通信。
referenceEn: We kept up correspondence with that company for several years.
We were in correspondence with the company for years.
rubricZh: correspondence 指通信（例如 keep up correspondence with、be in correspondence with）
時態合理即可（例如 kept、have kept）

items.instructionZh: 用 tuition 造一個句子，說說你上過的課或學費的情況（事實描述即可）。
referenceEn: I paid my own tuition for a short cooking course last year.
My parents helped me with my university tuition.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 tuition（例如 pay tuition、university tuition）
時態合理即可（例如 paid、pay）
